title: "Failed to find class with the requested plugin name" and "Could not find requested resource in ament index" in ROS 2 components: CMake registration, the export macro, plugin names, unsourced containers, Python nodes and stale libraries, measured
excerpt: What each ros2 component load error means: missing rclcpp_components_register_nodes, a missing export macro, wrong plugin names, unsourced containers, Python packages, undefined symbols and constructor exceptions, plus why a running container keeps old code.
